definition.description: Provisional engineering targets for this measured RTX 5080 development machine, manual updates, static scene, 1280x720. Adapter matching does not identify the CPU or certify other hardware. CPU API timings exclude total GPU/UI cost.

interpretation: Stable-range parent-rule updates are substantially cheaper in both original and repeat observations.

Boundary-crossing layout is not improved: final repeat48-field p95 2.165–2.199 ms versus old repeat1.468–2.150 ms. Smaller/earlier cases show timing variation; no crossing speedup or regression-free claim.
Measured APIs exclude setup, assertions, draw submission and GPU. Range fixture disables native input; ordinary game budget is static720p manual-update RTX5080 scope.
